# OpenJoystickDriver GitHub Issues

Snapshot of every issue returned by the GitHub CLI for [xsyetopz/OpenJoystickDriver](https://github.com/xsyetopz/OpenJoystickDriver/issues). GitHub remains the source of truth. Expiring authentication query parameters are stripped from quoted links.

Refresh from the repository root:

```bash
python3 scripts/ojd-export-external-issues.py
```
